thesis.infer: Price down with OI down and flat funding reads as deleveraging rather than new shorts, so there is little leverage to flush. The regime label has moved toward the tightening backdrop (Restrictive Macro lens, shrinking stablecoin supply) while the weekly trend still reads up and hl-cycles' own HTF phase reads expansion: the cycle frame and the regime disagree. Consensus is pricing a hold on Oct 28; we read hot oil and a September hike as keeping the risk skewed hawkish.
thesis.forecast: Base case (we lean here, low-confidence): BTC chops between the True Market Mean ($79.2K) and the ETF cost basis ($81.7K) into the Oct 28 FOMC; a daily close above $81.7K with realized cap growing would ease the risk-off leg, and a daily close above $105.6K (Mean MVRV price) would be the hl-cycles confirmation. Tail case (low-confidence): a daily close below $79.2K could put the STH cost basis ($74.4K, about 9% below) in play. Second tail case (low-confidence): a hold with dovish language and oil below $100 may let stablecoin supply recover and momentum extend. Consensus is pricing a hold; we read the risk as skewing to a hawkish surprise.
